results.native: Ciao. Come ti chiami? Il tuo nome, per favore. Item clàss: hùngry. Please sign hëre; I rëad the signatùre.
results.translation: Hello. What is your name? Your name, please. Item class: hungry. Please sign here; I read the signature.
results.narrative: At the Rift, mistranslations gather into a figure with the patient hunger of an unsigned form. Errata extends a hand. It has too many margins.

results.narrative: At the Rift, a seam in the air develops teeth and the manner of a receptionist. Errata turns toward you. Somewhere, a form fills itself in incorrectly.
